title: Loi n° 1/09 du 25 mai 2021 portant modification du Code de l'Environnement
evidence: No official page states an in-force date. Scanned FAOLEX copy (http://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/bur223581.pdf, read 2026-11-09, OCR, not official): signature line 'Fait à Gitega, le 25 mai 2021' and a final article saying the law enters into force on the day of its promulgation (OCR text).
notes: Link only: no official copy read. The LEAP title says 'portant modification', but the FAOLEX scan is a complete environmental code of 244 articles (Art. 244 repeals earlier contrary provisions). The Presidency listing (presidence.gov.bi/category/lois-promulguees/) has no post for it. Official copy and in-force date to confirm from the Bulletin officiel du Burundi or a Presidency post before any record is stored.

title: Loi n° 1/010 du 30 juin 2000 portant Code de l'Environnement de la République du Burundi
evidence: No official page read. The 2000 date is in the title on the LEAP page and in the preamble of the 2021 code ('Revu la Loi n°1/010 du 30 juin 2000'). Repeal by the 2021 code's final articles is read from the FAOLEX scan (OCR), not confirmed.
notes: Link only. Probably repealed in substance by Art. 244 of the 2021 code (the 2021 text repeals earlier provisions contrary to it; no 2000 article read as surviving). Status to confirm on an official copy. Not on the Presidency site (search for '1/010' returned no law post).
